title: One-step depth-3 compression under a random restriction
statement:
Fix $n \ge 1$, and let $D_1,\dots,D_{s_2}$ be DNF formulas on $n$ variables, each of width at most $w$ with $w \ge 1$, subject to the two syntactic conditions that within every term any two literals on the same variable coincide (so no term repeats a variable with opposite polarities) and that no term lists the same literal twice. Let $l \in \bbn$, and let $p \in \bbr$ satisfy $0 < p \le 1/(40w)$ and $p \le 1$. Draw a Bernoulli$(p)$ random restriction $\rho$ on the $n$ variables. Then with probability at least
\[
  1 - s_2\!\left(\left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^{l} + \exp\!\left(-\,\tfrac{np}{3}\right)\right)
\]
there exists a CNF formula $\Psi$ of width at most $l$ that computes the conjunction of the restricted gates: writing $D_i\!\restriction_\rho$ for the function $x \mapsto D_i(\rho.\mathrm{extend}\,x)$ obtained by fixing the coordinates set by $\rho$ and leaving the free coordinates to $x$, one has $\Psi(x) = \bigwedge_{i=1}^{s_2} \bigl(D_i\!\restriction_\rho\bigr)(x)$ for every assignment $x$.

replaced:
Given $s_2$ DNF gates each of width $\le w$ (with $w > 0$, non-degenerate and
duplicate-free terms) and $n > 0$, for any $0 < p \le 1/(40w)$ the Bernoulli$(p)$
random restriction satisfies, with probability at least
$1 - s_2\bigl((1/2)^l + \exp(-np/3)\bigr)$, that there exists a CNF $\Psi$ of width
$\le l$ whose evaluation equals the AND of the restricted gates. This is the depth-3
to depth-2 compression step.
